clarification.reason: Spearman rho measures the strength of the monotonic association between patristic separation and trait-state dissimilarity. It is not a slope in time or distance units and does not identify a decay timescale.

direction_unchanged: larger positive rho means stronger increase in trait dissimilarity across greater phylogenetic separation
scientific_question_unchanged: whether variation in the phylogenetic memory gradient is organized more strongly by trait identity or lineage identity
